# MeedyaDL 1.10.0

Under-the-hood housekeeping and dependency updates — nothing changes in how you use the app.

### Notes

- This release bumps MeedyaDL's version number to mark the significance of the GAMDL 3.6 support that landed in a recent update, and lays some invisible groundwork for a future cloud-storage feature. Nothing user-facing changes today.
